title: UPS module swap (fictional): replace power module 3 on UPS-B2
author: A. Example

steps.title: Confirm change window
steps.text: Confirm change record CHG-DEMO-0042 is approved and the customer notice for the window has been sent. Do not start outside the approved window.

steps.title: Check load headroom
steps.text: On the UPS-B2 display, read total output load. The remaining modules must be able to carry the load without module 3. Proceed only if total load is within the limit.

steps.title: Put on arc-flash PPE
steps.text: Put on arc-flash PPE rated for the cabinet label category, insulated gloves and face shield before opening any UPS-B2 cabinet door.
steps.warning: ARC-FLASH HAZARD: Do not open the cabinet door without the rated PPE. Do not work alone inside the cabinet.

steps.title: Isolate module 3 from the control panel
steps.text: At the UPS-B2 control panel select Module 3 and choose Isolate. Confirm the panel shows Module 3 as ISOLATED and that modules 1, 2 and 4 remain ONLINE.

steps.title: Lockout and tagout module 3 output breaker
steps.text: Open output breaker Q3 of module 3. Apply your personal lock and danger tag to Q3. A second person must independently verify that the lock and tag are on Q3 and the breaker handle cannot be moved.
steps.warning: LOCKOUT IS MANDATORY. Never remove or bypass another person's lock. Never skip the lockout.

steps.title: Prove zero voltage
steps.text: With a rated voltage tester, test the module 3 output terminals phase to phase and phase to ground. Test the tester on a known live source before and after. The reading must be near zero before any work on the module.

steps.title: Remove module 3
steps.text: Release the two front retaining screws and slide module 3 onto the module lift trolley. The module weighs about 85 kg: use the trolley and two people. Do not lift by hand.

steps.title: Inspect the backplane connector
steps.text: Inspect the empty slot backplane connector for bent pins, burn marks or debris. If any damage is found, stop and go to the rollback step.

steps.title: Insert replacement module
steps.text: Check the replacement module part number and firmware label match the removed module. Slide the replacement module into slot 3 and tighten the two retaining screws to 5 Nm.

steps.title: Remove lock and close input breaker
steps.text: Remove your own lock and tag from Q3. Close input breaker Q1 of module 3 and wait 120 seconds for pre-charge. Then read the DC bus voltage of module 3.

steps.title: Bring module 3 online and check output
steps.text: At the control panel select Module 3 and choose Online. After the module reports ONLINE, read the module 3 output voltage.

steps.title: Check load sharing and close out
steps.text: Compare the load on module 3 with modules 1, 2 and 4. Record the difference. Close change record CHG-DEMO-0042 only after the load share is within limits.

reading.label: Module 3 load share deviation from average

steps.title: ROLLBACK: return to original configuration
steps.text: Stop work. Select Module 3 and choose Isolate. Open breaker Q1 and Q3 and re-apply your lock and tag. Re-install the original module 3 if it was removed. Return module 3 to its previous state and notify the shift lead before any further action.
